args.summary:
Model successfully built and all L1 (topology), L2 (code) and L3 (mechanics) checks passed.

Bridge: cast-in-place prestressed concrete single-cell box girder, 4-span continuous unit 32+45+45+32 m (bearing centre lines), deck width 12.5 m, C50, modelled as a 2D spine beam (structure.idealization = spine_beam_2d) on a continuous_on_piers system, since pier column geometry was given.

Key section/material: cast_box B_top 12.5 / B_bot 6.5 / h 2.2 m; integrated A = 6.885 m2, I = 4.559 m4; Ec = 34500 MPa (C50, JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); gamma = 26.5 kN/m3 (owner override, MR-00); w = 182.45 kN/m, m = 18.60 t/m (girder self-weight only).

Supports: abutments 0 & 4 and piers 1 & 3 on PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric bearings (S = 10.10 / 13.54, Kv = 3.14e6 / 7.18e6 kN/m, Kh = 0; longitudinal free); pier 2 on plain (fixed) laminated elastomeric bearings (S = 14.69, Kv = 8.03e6 kN/m, Kh = 10909 kN/m). Piers modelled as single equivalent columns (2 x 1.4 m dia, C40 Ec = 32500 MPa; A = 3.079 m2, I = 0.3771 m4), heights 6/10/19 m, fixed base.

Live load (JTG D60-2015): Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes; qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 324/350/350/324 kN per span; xi = 0.78; impact factor mu = 0.1589 from f1 = 2.686 Hz.

Results: f1 (first vertical bending) = 2.686 Hz. Self-weight support reactions 2076 / 7739 / 8476 / 7721 / 2086 kN. Max lane positive moment 11420 kNm; max lane negative moment -9501 kNm. No unresolved problems.
